conclusion.diagnosis: Opponent functions were invoked, but APEX-style opponent agents appear to receive the unadapted seat-1 observation and act as if farms[0] is their own farm. Agent0's view of farms[1] stays undeveloped, while agent1's observation farms[0] mirrors agent0's developed farm. Step 2 therefore collected games against opponents that did not develop their actual seat-1 farm.
conclusion.recommended_next_step: Add a seat-1 observation adapter for imported APEX-style opponent policies, then run a tiny pilot before any new large collection.
